title: Plan Entry Requirements for the Pocketwire Personal Account
content:
Each plan of the Pocketwire Personal Account has its own entry requirements, which an applicant or an existing customer must meet to be placed on that plan.

| Plan | Minimum age (years) | Identity verification status | US mobile number | Subscription payment method on file | Minimum account age (days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Lite | 18 | Not started — the plan opens without completed identity verification | Required | — | — |
| Pocketwire Core | 18 | Verified | Required | — | — |
| Pocketwire Plus | 18 | Verified | — | Required | — |
| Pocketwire Prime | 18 | Verified | — | Required | — |
| Pocketwire Onyx | 18 | Verified | — | Required | — |
| Pocketwire Summit | 18 | Verified | — | Required | 90 |

A dash means the item is not among that plan's entry requirements.

### Points of reading

- **Which plans need identity verification?** Every plan other than Pocketwire Lite requires the identity verification status verified; Pocketwire Lite is the plan for a customer whose identity verification has not started.
- **Which plans need a payment method for the subscription?** Pocketwire Plus, Pocketwire Prime, Pocketwire Onyx and Pocketwire Summit, the plans that carry a subscription.
- **Is any plan tied to how long the account has existed?** Only Pocketwire Summit, which requires an account age of at least 90 days.
- **Does the minimum age differ by plan?** No; it is 18 years on every plan.
